column3: “to make artistic designs” renders “to devise devices.”
“all who are skillful” renders “every wise of heart,” and “skill” renders “wisdom.”
NASB supplies “gold” in “the pure gold lampstand.”
“the woven garments” renders “garments of serad,” a word whose meaning is uncertain.
“his people” renders “its kinsmen”; “shall surely be put to death” renders an emphatic doubled verb (also in verse 15).
“a sabbath of complete rest” renders “a sabbath of sabbath observance (shabbaton).”
